<style data-sjc-site-copper>
:root{--primary-color:#0B0906!important;--accent3-color:#DE8634!important;--accent2-color:#F6BC76!important;--accent4-color:#F6BC76!important}
body{background:#0B0906!important}
header#global-header{background:#0B0906!important;border-bottom:1px solid #DE8634!important;box-shadow:none!important}
header#global-header img[data-logo]{height:76px!important;width:76px!important;object-fit:contain;border-radius:0!important}
@media(max-width:1023px){header#global-header img[data-logo]{height:60px!important;width:60px!important}}
.sjc-mark .m2{color:#F6BC76!important}
#sf0of7a,#svslhero,#svslbook{background-image:radial-gradient(900px 520px at 78% 14%,rgba(222,134,52,.10),transparent 62%),linear-gradient(rgba(222,134,52,.045) 1px,transparent 1px),linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(222,134,52,.045) 1px,transparent 1px)!important;background-color:#0B0906!important}
#svslhero div.absolute,#sf0of7a div.absolute[class*="bg-[var(--primary-color)]"],#svslhero div.absolute,#sf0of7a div.absolute[class*="bg-[var(--accent3-color)]"]{background:#DE8634!important;opacity:.04!important}
#sf0of7a span[style*="accent3"],#sf0of7a li span:first-child,.sjc-drop span[aria-hidden]{background:transparent!important;border:1.5px solid #DE8634!important;color:#F6BC76!important}
html body a.sjc-cta[class][data-sjc-link],html body a.sjc-cta[class][data-sjc-link]:hover{background:repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(255,255,255,.05) 0 1px,rgba(0,0,0,.05) 1px 2px),linear-gradient(90deg,#8F4515 0%,#A25718 16%,#BF7530 31%,#D58A42 50%,#BF7530 69%,#A25718 84%,#8F4515 100%)!important;border:1px solid #F0AF66!important;color:#1A0E06!important;box-shadow:0 0 28px rgba(224,138,46,.4),0 0 10px rgba(240,175,102,.28),0 8px 22px rgba(0,0,0,.55),inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,232,196,.45),inset 0 -1px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.35)!important}
html body button.sjc-twin-orb.sjc-twin-orb.sjc-twin-orb[class]{background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 24%,#DE9550 0,#D58A42 18%,#C0702A 42%,#B35F1D 66%,#8F4515 100%)!important;border:1.5px solid #F6C48A!important;filter:none!important;animation:sjccopperpulse 2.4s ease-in-out infinite!important}
html body button.sjc-twin-orb.sjc-twin-orb.sjc-twin-orb[class] svg{color:#1A0E06!important;stroke:#1A0E06!important}
.sjc-drop a{color:#fff!important}.sjc-drop{border-color:#DE8634!important}
html body .sjc-pill,html body div[data-sjc-ownbg]:not(a){background:transparent!important;border:1.5px solid #DE8634!important;color:#fff!important;box-shadow:none!important}
.sjc-pill *,div[data-sjc-ownbg] span{color:#fff!important}
.sjc-pill b,.sjc-pill strong,.sjc-pill b *{color:#F6BC76!important}

header#global-header img[data-logo]{content:url("https://ddhmhtqvn5lepkpr.public.blob.vercel-storage.com/sites/sjc-website/uploads/1790984824193-sjc-ring-copper-256.webp")!important}
[data-sjc-vsl-player]{border-color:#DE8634!important;background:#0B0906!important;box-shadow:0 0 28px rgba(224,138,46,.25),0 20px 50px rgba(0,0,0,.55)!important}
[data-sjc-vsl-player] div[style*="border:3px solid"]{border-color:#DE8634!important}
[data-sjc-vsl-player] div[style*="border-left:26px"]{border-left-color:#DE8634!important}
#svslbook p[style*="#ffd700"]{color:#F6BC76!important}
section[class*="from-[var(--primary-color)]"]{background:#0B0906!important}

html body section.code-section{background-color:#0B0906!important;background-image:radial-gradient(900px 520px at 78% 14%,rgba(222,134,52,.08),transparent 62%),linear-gradient(rgba(222,134,52,.045) 1px,transparent 1px),linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(222,134,52,.045) 1px,transparent 1px)!important;background-size:auto,64px 64px,64px 64px!important}
html body section.code-section h1,html body section.code-section h2,html body section.code-section h3,html body section.code-section p{color:#fff}
html body section.code-section .label{color:#F6BC76!important}
html body section.code-section span[style*="accent3"]{background:transparent!important;border:1.5px solid #DE8634!important;color:#F6BC76!important}
#sjcsix .sixgrid>div{background:#15100B!important;border:1px solid #DE8634!important}
#sjcsix .sixgrid>div h3,#sjcsix .sixgrid>div p{color:#fff!important}
#sjcsix a.sjc-card-link{color:#F6BC76!important}
html body p[data-sjc-ownbg]{border-color:#DE8634!important}
html body p[data-sjc-ownbg] strong{color:#F6BC76!important}
html body p[data-sjc-ownbg] span{color:#fff!important}
#sxq4oqf div[data-sjc-box]{background:rgba(222,134,52,.06)!important;border:1px solid rgba(222,134,52,.55)!important}
#sxq4oqf div[data-sjc-box]>div:first-child{background:rgba(222,134,52,.18)!important}
#su0uldl h2,#su0uldl h2 span{color:#F6BC76!important}


/*drop*/
@media (min-width:1024px){
#global-header .sjc-drop a,#global-header .sjc-drop a[style]{background:#26211C!important;border:2px solid #DE8634!important;color:#F6BC76!important;box-shadow:0 6px 18px rgba(0,0,0,.45)!important}
#global-header .sjc-drop a *{color:inherit!important;border-color:#DE8634!important}
#global-header .sjc-drop a:hover,#global-header .sjc-drop a:focus{background:#B35F1D!important;border-color:#F0AF66!important;color:#1A0E06!important}
#global-header .sjc-drop a:hover *,#global-header .sjc-drop a:focus *{color:#1A0E06!important;border-color:#1A0E06!important}
#global-header .sjc-trigger[aria-expanded="true"],#global-header .sjc-trigger:hover{color:#F6BC76!important}
}
/*end drop*/
/*mdrop*/
@media (max-width:1023px){
#global-header [data-landingsite-mobile-menu] a,#global-header [data-landingsite-mobile-menu] a[style]{background:#26211C!important;border:2px solid #DE8634!important;color:#F6BC76!important;box-shadow:0 6px 18px rgba(0,0,0,.45)!important}
#global-header [data-landingsite-mobile-menu] a *{color:inherit!important;border-color:#DE8634!important}
#global-header [data-landingsite-mobile-menu] a span[aria-hidden]{background:transparent!important;border:1.5px solid #DE8634!important;color:#F6BC76!important}
#global-header [data-landingsite-mobile-menu] a:hover,#global-header [data-landingsite-mobile-menu] a:focus{background:#B35F1D!important;border-color:#F0AF66!important;color:#1A0E06!important}
#global-header [data-landingsite-mobile-menu] a:hover *,#global-header [data-landingsite-mobile-menu] a:focus *{color:#1A0E06!important;border-color:#1A0E06!important}
#global-header [data-landingsite-mobile-menu] .sjc-mgroup{background:#26211C!important;border:2px solid rgba(222,134,52,.55)!important;color:#F6BC76!important;box-shadow:0 6px 18px rgba(0,0,0,.45)!important}
}
/*end mdrop*/
/*heropill*/
html body span.eyebrow:has(> .dot){display:inline-block!important;background:transparent!important;border:1px solid #DE8634!important;border-radius:9999px!important;padding:16px 32px!important;color:#fff!important;letter-spacing:normal!important;text-transform:none!important;font-weight:700!important;line-height:1.5!important;box-shadow:0 10px 15px -3px rgba(0,0,0,.1),0 4px 6px -4px rgba(0,0,0,.1)!important}
html body span.eyebrow:has(> .dot) > .dot{display:none!important}
html body span.eyebrow:has(> .dot) > span:not(.dot){font-size:20px!important;color:#fff!important}
/*end heropill*/
/*anchor*/
#apply,#start{scroll-margin-top:var(--sjc-hdr,97px)}
/*end anchor*/
/*sjc-only-text*/
/* These two used to live in the shared stylesheet (app/globals.css), where they applied to EVERY site in the
   builder. Light text is right on this dark site and unreadable on a client's light one. They belong here. */
html body .sjc-design .text-\[var\(--gray-text-color\)\]{color:#D9CBB8!important}
html body .band--gray.band--gray,html body .band--white.band--white{--body:#E9DCCB;--muted:#B8A58C}
/*end sjc-only-text*/
/*hover*/
html body a.sjc-cta[class][data-sjc-link]{transition:background .2s,box-shadow .2s,transform .2s!important}
html body a.sjc-cta[class][data-sjc-link]:hover,html body a.sjc-cta[class][data-sjc-link]:focus-visible{background:repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(255,255,255,.05) 0 1px,rgba(0,0,0,.05) 1px 2px),linear-gradient(90deg,#9A4B16 0%,#B0611E 16%,#D08A42 31%,#EBA65C 50%,#D08A42 69%,#B0611E 84%,#9A4B16 100%)!important;border-color:#FBE3BC!important;box-shadow:0 0 40px rgba(240,160,80,.6),0 0 14px rgba(251,227,188,.4),0 10px 26px rgba(0,0,0,.6),inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,232,196,.6)!important;transform:translateY(-2px)!important;color:#1A0E06!important}
/*end hover*/
/*app*/
#apply ~ * button[type=submit],#apply button[type=submit],section:has(#apply) button[type=submit]{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#8F4515 0%,#A25718 16%,#BF7530 31%,#D58A42 50%,#BF7530 69%,#A25718 84%,#8F4515 100%)!important;color:#1A0E06!important;border:1px solid #F0AF66!important;border-radius:999px!important;box-shadow:0 0 24px rgba(224,138,46,.35)!important;font-weight:700!important}
section:has(#apply) form input:focus,section:has(#apply) form select:focus,section:has(#apply) form textarea:focus{box-shadow:0 0 0 2px #DE8634!important;border-color:transparent!important}
section:has(#apply) h2{color:#fff!important}
/*end app*/
/*tones*/
header#global-header{background:#26211C!important}
footer#global-footer{background:#26211C!important;border-top:1px solid #DE8634!important}
footer#global-footer img[data-logo]{content:url("https://ddhmhtqvn5lepkpr.public.blob.vercel-storage.com/sites/sjc-website/uploads/1790984824193-sjc-ring-copper-256.webp")!important;height:56px!important;width:56px!important;object-fit:contain}
/*end tones*/
html body [data-puck-section],html body section:not(.code-section){background-color:#16120E!important;background-image:none!important}
html body section:not(.code-section) h1,html body section:not(.code-section) h2,html body section:not(.code-section) p{color:#fff!important}
html body a.sjc-sys-card{background:#211C17!important;border:1px solid #8F4515!important;color:#E9DCCB!important}
html body a.sjc-sys-card span,html body a.sjc-sys-card p{color:#E9DCCB!important}
html body a.sjc-sys-card strong,html body a.sjc-sys-card b,html body a.sjc-sys-card h3,html body a.sjc-sys-card>span:first-child{color:#F6BC76!important}
html body a.sjc-sys-card span[aria-hidden=true][style*="9999"]{color:#1A0E06!important;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#F0AF66,#B35F1D)!important}
html body a.sjc-sys-card:hover{border-color:#F0AF66!important;box-shadow:0 0 18px rgba(222,134,52,.35)!important}
html body a.sjc-sys-card--layer{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#26211C,#16120E)!important;border:1px solid #DE8634!important}
html body a.sjc-sys-card--layer *{color:#F6BC76!important}
html body div.card{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#26211C,#1A1510)!important;border:1px solid #5A3418!important;box-shadow:0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.45)!important}
html body h3.card{background:none!important;border:0!important;box-shadow:none!important;padding:0!important}
html body .card h3,html body h3.card{color:#F6BC76!important}html body .card p{color:#D9CBB8!important}
html body .card svg,html body .card [class*=icon]{color:#DE8634!important;stroke:#DE8634!important}
html body div.card [class*=icon],html body div.card .ico,html body div.card>div:first-child{background:rgba(222,134,52,.12)!important;border-color:#8F4515!important}
html body section .rt,html body section .rt p,html body section .rt li{color:#D9CBB8!important}
html body a.sjc-sys-link,html body section a.sjc-sys-link{color:#F6BC76!important;text-decoration-color:#DE8634!important}
html body section .label{background:rgba(222,134,52,.10)!important;border:1px solid #DE8634!important;color:#F6BC76!important}
html body section [class*=pill],html body section [class*=eyebrow]{border-color:#DE8634!important;color:#F6BC76!important}

html body section h3:not(.card){color:#F6BC76!important}
html body .sjc-design{--cyan:#DE8634!important;--accent-color:#DE8634!important}
html body .sjc-design .btn--primary,html body .sjc-design .btn--primary:visited{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#8F4515,#D58A42 50%,#8F4515)!important;color:#1A0E06!important;border:1px solid #F0AF66!important;box-shadow:0 10px 30px rgba(222,134,52,.25)!important}
html body .sjc-design .ep__n,html body .sjc-design .cathead span,html body .sjc-design .cover span{color:#F6BC76!important}
html body .sjc-design section p a:not(.btn):not(.sjc-cta){color:#F6BC76!important}
html body .sjc-design .cover{color:#D9CBB8!important}
html body a.sjc-sys-card span[aria-hidden=true][style*="9999"]{color:#1A0E06!important;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#F0AF66,#B35F1D)!important}
html body a.sjc-sys-card[aria-current=page]{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#5A3418,#2A1A0E)!important;border:2px solid #F0AF66!important;box-shadow:0 0 22px rgba(222,134,52,.45)!important}
html body a.sjc-sys-card[aria-current=page] span{color:#FFF3E0!important}
html body .sjc-design .eps .cathead,html body .sjc-design .eps .ep{border-color:#8F4515!important}
html body .sjc-design .ep__n,html body .sjc-design .ep__n *{border-color:#DE8634!important}
html body .sjc-design .ep a:not(.btn):not(.cover){color:#F6BC76!important;text-decoration-color:#8F4515!important}
html body .sjc-design .ep__work strong,html body .sjc-design .ep__work em{color:#F6BC76!important}
/*rotate*/
html body main > :nth-child(odd) section:not(section section):not(#_r1):not(#_r2){background-color:#0B0906!important}
html body main > :nth-child(even) section:not(section section):not(#_r1):not(#_r2){background-color:#211C17!important}
html body main > :nth-child(odd) > div[style*="background"]:not(#_r1){background-color:#0B0906!important}
html body main > :nth-child(even) > div[style*="background"]:not(#_r1){background-color:#211C17!important}
html body main > :nth-child(odd):not(#_r1):not(#_r2){background-color:#0B0906!important}
html body main > :nth-child(even):not(#_r1):not(#_r2){background-color:#211C17!important}
/*end rotate*/

footer#global-footer .sjc-mark .m2{color:#F6BC76!important}
/*mockups*/
html body .sjc-design .thread{background:#0B0906!important;border-color:rgba(222,134,52,.28)!important}
html body .sjc-design .msg p{background:#211C17!important;color:#E9DCCB!important;border-color:rgba(222,134,52,.18)!important}
html body .sjc-design .msg--her p{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#B35F1D,#8F4515)!important;color:#FFF3E0!important;border-color:#DE8634!important}
html body .sjc-design .msg__who{color:#B8A58C!important}
html body .sjc-design .msg--her .msg__who{color:#F6BC76!important}
html body .sjc-design .thread__take{color:#D9CBB8!important;border-color:rgba(222,134,52,.2)!important}
/*roster-pills*/
html body .sjc-design .roster{background:#FFFFFF!important;border:1px solid #EADFD2!important;box-shadow:0 24px 60px rgba(0,0,0,.45)!important;padding-bottom:14px!important}
html body .sjc-design .rhead{background:#F7F3EE!important;border-color:#EADFD2!important;margin-bottom:10px!important}
html body .sjc-design .rhead b{color:#1A1410!important}
html body .sjc-design .rhead span{color:#8A7A68!important}
html body .sjc-design .rrow{margin:8px 18px!important;border:1px solid #93B4DC!important;border-radius:16px!important;background:#C6DAF1!important}
html body .sjc-design .rrow:last-child{border-bottom:1px solid #F0AF66!important}
html body .sjc-design .rwho b,html body .sjc-design .rrole{color:#14223A!important}
html body .sjc-design .rwho span{color:#4E5F78!important}
html body .sjc-design .rrow--ai{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#C8742E,#9A4E19)!important;border:1px solid #F0AF66!important;margin-top:8px!important}
html body .sjc-design .rrow--ai:first-of-type,html body .sjc-design .rrow:not(.rrow--ai) + .rrow--ai{margin-top:22px!important}
html body .sjc-design .rrow--ai .rwho b,html body .sjc-design .rrow--ai .rrole{color:#FFF3E0!important}
html body .sjc-design .rrow--ai .rwho span{color:#F6D9B5!important}
html body .sjc-design .rav--ai{background:#1A0E06!important;color:#F6BC76!important;border:1px solid #F0AF66!important}
html body .sjc-design .rwho em{background:#1A0E06!important;color:#F6BC76!important;border:1px solid #F0AF66!important}
/*end roster-pills*/
/*end mockups*/
@keyframes sjccopperpulse{0%,100%{box-shadow:0 0 0 10px rgba(222,134,52,.22),0 0 0 22px rgba(222,134,52,.12),0 0 0 36px rgba(222,134,52,.06),0 0 40px 18px rgba(222,134,52,.20),inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,232,196,.5)}50%{box-shadow:0 0 0 14px rgba(222,134,52,.30),0 0 0 30px rgba(222,134,52,.16),0 0 0 48px rgba(222,134,52,.08),0 0 60px 28px rgba(222,134,52,.32),inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,232,196,.5)}}
/* The orb glows on EVERY phone (Steven 10-03: 'my tap to talk orb does not glow' on mobile). A phone set to reduce motion used to get a faint still ring here; the glow is a slow fade, not movement, so it runs for everyone. */
html body .sjc-twin-stage:not([data-state="listening"])::before{background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 55%,rgba(222,134,52,.95) 0%,rgba(222,134,52,.45) 40%,rgba(222,134,52,0) 70%)!important}

/* THE TWIN'S CARD IN COPPER AND BLACK (2026-10-04, Steven: 'the color palette is all wrong with this new copper background'). The shared sheet's card is white with navy tiles and yellow type; this is SJC's skin for it and lives here because the shared sheet serves every site. */
html body .sjc-call-card.sjc-call-card[class]{background:#14100C!important;color:#fff!important;border:1.5px solid #DE8634!important;border-radius:1.25rem!important;box-shadow:0 0 28px rgba(224,138,46,.22),0 18px 44px rgba(0,0,0,.65)!important}
html body .sjc-call-card h2.sjc-cc-title{color:#F6BC76!important}
html body .sjc-call-card p.sjc-cc-hint{color:#E9DCCB!important}
html body .sjc-call-card .sjc-cc-chips button,html body .sjc-call-card .sjc-cc-slots button{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#2A231C,#17120D)!important;border:1.5px solid #DE8634!important;color:#F6BC76!important;box-shadow:none!important}
html body .sjc-call-card .sjc-cc-chips button:hover,html body .sjc-call-card .sjc-cc-slots button:hover,html body .sjc-call-card .sjc-cc-slots button.sjc-cc-picked{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#8F4515 0%,#BF7530 31%,#D58A42 50%,#BF7530 69%,#8F4515 100%)!important;border-color:#F6C48A!important;color:#1A0E06!important}
html body .sjc-call-card .sjc-cc-line{border:1.5px solid rgba(222,134,52,.55)!important;background:rgba(222,134,52,.07)!important}
html body .sjc-call-card .sjc-cc-line.sjc-cc-flash{border-color:#F6C48A!important;background:rgba(246,188,118,.18)!important}
html body .sjc-call-card span.sjc-cc-k{color:#F6BC76!important}
html body .sjc-call-card span.sjc-cc-v,html body .sjc-call-card input.sjc-cc-input{color:#fff!important}
html body .sjc-call-card span.sjc-cc-fix,html body .sjc-call-card .sjc-cc-line.sjc-cc-ask span.sjc-cc-v,html body .sjc-call-card span.sjc-cc-add,html body .sjc-call-card p.sjc-cc-status{color:#F6BC76!important}
html body .sjc-call-card button.sjc-cc-ok{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#8F4515 0%,#BF7530 31%,#D58A42 50%,#BF7530 69%,#8F4515 100%)!important;border:1.5px solid #F6C48A!important;color:#1A0E06!important}
html body .sjc-call-card .sjc-cc-done-big{color:#F6BC76!important}
html body .sjc-call-card .sjc-cc-done-when{color:#fff!important}
html body .sjc-call-card .sjc-cc-talk p.sjc-cc-them,html body .sjc-call-card p.sjc-cc-caption{background:#221B14!important;color:#fff!important;border:1px solid rgba(222,134,52,.4)!important}
html body .sjc-call-card .sjc-cc-talk p.sjc-cc-you{background:#E9DCCB!important;color:#1A0E06!important}
html body button.sjc-twin-orb.sjc-twin-orb[class]{outline:none!important}
html body button.sjc-twin-orb.sjc-twin-orb[class]:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #F6C48A!important;outline-offset:4px!important}
html body .sjc-twin-stage[data-state="listening"]::before{background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 55%,rgba(246,196,138,.85) 0%,rgba(246,196,138,.38) 40%,rgba(246,196,138,0) 70%)!important}

/* sjc-hero-wrap (2026-10-04, Steven: 'it should use the whole column like the text underneath it'): the headline fills the column; 'pretty' only stops one word being left alone on the last line. NOT balance, which split the lines evenly and left half the column empty. */
html body [data-sjc-hero-split] h1,html body [data-sjc-hero-split] h1 + p{text-wrap:pretty!important}

/* sjc-link-copper (2026-10-04, Steven: 'not crazy about that yellow'): text links on SJC are light copper, never yellow. */
html body a.sjc-card-link,html body .sjc-design a.sjc-card-link{color:#F6BC76!important;text-decoration-color:#DE8634!important}
html body a.sjc-card-link:hover{color:#fff!important}
</style>
<style>
  /* ⛔ gap-8 IS NOT IN THIS SITE'S COMPILED TAILWIND SHEET -- swapping space-x-8 for it collapsed
     the nav to zero spacing, silently. space-x-8 stays; this only cancels the stray margin-right
     that was sitting on the first item and making the gap after it 64px against 32px elsewhere.
     ⚠️ Broadened from `> a:first-child` to `> *:first-child` on 2026-08-30: the first child of the
     desktop nav is now the Services dropdown DIV, so the `a` selector stopped matching. */
  #global-header nav > *:first-child { margin-right: 0; }
  /* Same stray margin in the drawer: space-y-3 puts 12px between items, but the FIRST link
     also carried its own margin-bottom, so the gap under the first item read as a section break
     the others did not have. Zero it, and put the breathing room where it belongs -- between the
     blue bar and the list. Plain CSS, so no sealed-sheet class to miss. */
  #global-header [data-landingsite-mobile-menu] > div > *:first-child { margin-bottom: 0; }
  #global-header [data-landingsite-mobile-menu] > div { padding-top: 28px; padding-bottom: 8px; }

  /* ── DROPDOWNS (added 2026-08-30 with the deep pages) ──────────────────────────────────────
     ⛔ PLAIN CSS ON PURPOSE. The imported sheet 7b6d59e91bbcfde5 is compiled and frozen at 1,436
     class names with no `md:`/`gap-*` utilities in it -- a class that is not already in the sheet
     renders as NOTHING, with no error. Anything new here has to be hand-written CSS.
     ⚠️ CSS-only (hover + focus-within), no JS. The panels live inside `hidden lg:flex`, so they
     only exist at >=1024px where a pointer does; touch users get the drawer below, which lists
     every link flat. focus-within is what keeps it keyboard-reachable. */
  #global-header .sjc-menu { position: relative; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; }
  #global-header .sjc-trigger {
    display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; background: none; border: 0; padding: 0;
    margin: 0; cursor: pointer; color: #fff; font: inherit; line-height: inherit;
    transition: color .3s;
  }
  #global-header .sjc-menu:hover .sjc-trigger,
  #global-header .sjc-menu:focus-within .sjc-trigger { color: var(--accent2-color); }
  #global-header .sjc-trigger svg {
    width: .55em; height: .55em; display: inline-block; transition: transform .25s;
  }
  #global-header .sjc-menu:hover .sjc-trigger svg,
  #global-header .sjc-menu:focus-within .sjc-trigger svg { transform: rotate(180deg); }
  /* ⚠️ THE HOVER BRIDGE. Without it the 14px gap between the trigger and the panel is dead space,
     the pointer crosses it, :hover drops and the menu shuts before you reach an item. */
  #global-header .sjc-menu::after {
    content: ""; position: absolute; top: 100%; left: 0; right: 0; height: 16px;
  }
  /* ⛔ THE PANEL'S LOOK IS NOT SET HERE ANY MORE (2026-09-01). Background, border, shadow and
     the link capsules moved to app/globals.css so the desktop panel and the phone drawer are
     skinned from ONE place. Those rules are !important and will beat anything you add below.
     What still lives here: where the panel sits, the hover bridge, and the open/close. */
  #global-header .sjc-drop {
    position: absolute; top: 100%; left: 50%; transform: translate(-50%, 8px);
    min-width: 252px; padding: 9px 0; z-index: 80;
    background: var(--primary-color); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.13); border-radius: 12px;
    box-shadow: 0 20px 44px rgba(0,0,0,.34);
    opacity: 0; visibility: hidden; transition: opacity .2s ease, transform .2s ease;
  }
  #global-header .sjc-menu:hover .sjc-drop,
  #global-header .sjc-menu:focus-within .sjc-drop {
    opacity: 1; visibility: visible; transform: translate(-50%, 0);
  }
  #global-header .sjc-drop a {
    display: block; padding: 11px 22px; color: #fff; white-space: nowrap; text-decoration: none;
    transition: background .2s, color .2s;
  }
  #global-header .sjc-drop a:hover, #global-header .sjc-drop a:focus {
    background: rgba(255,255,255,.10); color: var(--accent2-color);
  }
  /* ── the same links, flat, in the mobile drawer ─────────────────────────────────────────── */
  #global-header .sjc-mgroup {
    color:#fff; font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: .18em; text-transform: uppercase;
    padding: 16px 0 2px;
  }
  #global-header [data-landingsite-mobile-menu] a.sjc-sub { padding-left: 15px; }

  #global-header .sjc-mark,#global-footer .sjc-mark{
    display:inline-flex;align-items:baseline;gap:.26em;line-height:1.05;white-space:nowrap;
  }
  #global-header .sjc-mark span,#global-footer .sjc-mark span{
    font-family:var(--font-playfair),"Playfair Display",Georgia,serif;
    font-variant:small-caps;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:.045em;line-height:1.05;
  }
  #global-header .sjc-mark .m1{color:#fff}
  #global-header .sjc-mark .m2{color:var(--accent2-color,#ffd700)}
  #global-footer .sjc-mark .m1{color:#fff}

  #global-footer .sjc-mark span{font-size:23px}
  #global-header a:hover .sjc-mark .m1,#global-footer a:hover .sjc-mark .m1{color:var(--accent2-color,#ffd700)}

  /* ── THE FIVE SYSTEMS, THEN THE LAYER ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
     ⛔ THE PILL IS THE DIVIDER. A rule between the five and the sixth item failed twice - white
     vanished over a white band, grey vanished over everything, and a 1px line is not visible to
     a human either way. Steven, 2026-09-02: "the pill is the divider because it's different than
     the rest." So the caption moved INSIDE the AI pill as a second line, the pill is taller than
     the other five, and its border is money green instead of gold. Nothing to see through, and
     it reads on any background the menu happens to open over. */
  #global-header .sjc-drop-layer{border-color:#85bb65 !important;padding-top:11px !important;
    padding-bottom:11px !important;line-height:1.25}
  #global-header .sjc-drop-layer:hover,#global-header .sjc-drop-layer:focus{
    background:#85bb65 !important;border-color:#85bb65 !important;color:#08120a !important}
  #global-header .sjc-layer-sub{display:block;margin-top:5px;font-size:9.5px;font-weight:700;
    letter-spacing:.13em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#85bb65}
  #global-header .sjc-drop-layer:hover .sjc-layer-sub,
  #global-header .sjc-drop-layer:focus .sjc-layer-sub{color:#0b2413}
